Source cards stay preserved internally. Read-only fields appear individually above. Exact effects on unrepresented source properties are checked by the existing compatibility rules during synchronization.
Keep the whole Contako version and send its changes after verification. Compatible unknown properties remain preserved.

Use the whole Proton version. Local custom dates, phonetic names and eligible local labels remain preserved. Independent group changes are checked separately.
Android is updated through normal synchronization. Saving this choice does not mean either destination has confirmed it.
Contako groups are the current local assignments; Proton groups come from the saved remote version.
